description: Java Entity class representing product attributes in the e-commerce application, including mapping annotations, fields, and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: ProductAttribute
classes.description: Entity class modeling product attribute details, including prices, weight, options, and various flags.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the product attribute.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the product attribute.

methods.name: getProductOptionSortOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the sort order of the product option.

methods.name: setProductOptionSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order of the product option.

methods.name: getProductAttributeIsFree
methods.description: Indicates if the attribute is free.

methods.name: setProductAttributeIsFree
methods.description: Sets whether the attribute is free.

methods.name: getProductAttributeWeight
methods.description: Retrieves the weight associated with this attribute.

methods.name: setProductAttributeWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight for this attribute.

methods.name: getAttributeDefault
methods.description: Checks if this attribute is default.

methods.name: setAttributeDefault
methods.description: Sets this attribute as default or not.

methods.name: getAttributeRequired
methods.description: Checks if this attribute is required.

methods.name: setAttributeRequired
methods.description: Sets whether the attribute is required.

methods.name: getAttributeDisplayOnly
methods.description: Checks if attribute is display only.

methods.name: setAttributeDisplayOnly
methods.description: Sets whether the attribute is display only.

methods.name: getAttributeDiscounted
methods.description: Checks if attribute has a discount.

methods.name: setAttributeDiscounted
methods.description: Sets whether this attribute is discounted.

methods.name: getProductOption
methods.description: Retrieves the associated product option.

methods.name: setProductOption
methods.description: Sets the associated product option.

methods.name: getProductOptionValue
methods.description: Retrieves the product option value.

methods.name: setProductOptionValue
methods.description: Sets the product option value.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the associated product.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Sets the associated product.

methods.name: getAttributeSortOrder
methods.description: Gets the display sort order.

methods.name: setAttributeSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the display sort order.

methods.name: getAttributeAdditionalWeight
methods.description: Gets the additional weight attribute.

methods.name: setAttributeAdditionalWeight
methods.description: Sets the additional weight attribute.

methods.name: getAttributePrice
methods.description: Retrieves the attribute price as string.

methods.name: setAttributePrice
methods.description: Sets the attribute price as string.

methods.name: getProductAttributePrice
methods.description: Retrieves the BigDecimal price of the attribute.

methods.name: setProductAttributePrice
